jobs.title: Director of Engineering, See & Scout
jobs.description:
We’re Blue River, a team of innovators driven to create intelligent machinery that solves monumental problems for our customers. We empower our customers - farmers, construction crews, and foresters to implement safer and more sustainable solutions, driving increased profitability with less reliance on scarce labor. We believe that focusing on the small stuff, pixel-by-pixel and task-by-task, leads to big gains.

Blue River Technology aligns with John Deere’s vision to “innovate on behalf of humanity” by quickly identifying and solving high-value, high-uncertainty challenges in AI, machine learning, computer vision, and robotics. BRT acts as a research and development flywheel, building not only new products but also new platforms that reliably create value for both Deere and its customers. From fully autonomous machines to highly precise farming equipment, BRT and Deere are partnering to deliver technical breakthroughs across industries such as agriculture and construction.

Our people are at the heart of what we do. Through cross-disciplinary collaboration, this mission-driven team is eager to define the new frontier of robotics. We are always asking hard questions, rapidly iterating, and getting our boots in the field to figure it out. We won’t give up until we’ve made a tangible and positive impact on the planet!

Blue River Technology is based in Santa Clara, CA.

Summary

Within the See & Scout team, we turn machine vision into a production system intelligence capability. As Director of Engineering, you will be the primary architect of the systems and culture that help customers make better decisions across every acre they farm. You will lead the charge in bridging the gap between muddy boots in the field and high-performance distributed systems in the cloud.

This is a high-impact leadership position reporting directly to See & Spray's VP of Engineering. You will own the technical roadmap and the professional growth of a multidisciplinary team of data, ML, and robotics engineers. You aren't just managing people; you are building the engine that scales our ambitious long-term vision.

Employment Type: Full-Time
Work Location: Remote in the United States. Expect to be onsite in Santa Clara, CA, 1-2x per quarter.
Visa sponsorship: Open to visa sponsorship.

Job Responsibilities

The main job responsibilities include:

Lead and Grow the Organization: Recruit, mentor, develop, and retain a high-performing multidisciplinary engineering organization spanning software, data, machine learning, and robotics. Foster a culture of accountability, technical excellence, rapid iteration, and continuous learning.
Own Technical Strategy & Architecture: Define the technical vision, architecture, and multi-year roadmap for the See & Scout platform. Lead architectural decisions across large-scale data platforms, cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, and machine learning capabilities.
Build Scalable Data & ML Platforms: Design and oversee the complete data and machine learning lifecycle, including telemetry and imagery ingestion, storage, processing, feature engineering, model training, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
Drive Platform & Product Delivery: Own the end-to-end software development lifecycle, ensuring scalable infrastructure, reliable deployments, operational excellence, and rapid delivery of customer-facing capabilities.
Partner Across the Organization: Collaborate closely with Product Management, Agronomy, Operations, Systems Engineering, Robotics, Machine Learning, and Program Management teams to define strategy, prioritize investments, and deliver customer value.
Scale for the Future: Build platforms capable of supporting Blue River's long-term "Individual Plant" vision by solving large-scale data management, cloud processing, edge computing, and machine learning challenges.
Provide Technical Leadership: Lead technical strategy through architecture reviews, design discussions, and engineering decision-making while balancing long-term platform investments with short-term product delivery.
Drive Customer Impact: Translate customer and grower needs into scalable platform capabilities that generate actionable insights from real-world agricultural data.
Influence Across Blue River & John Deere: Build strong partnerships across organizations, align stakeholders around technical strategy, and help drive adoption of shared platform capabilities.

Required Experience And Skills

Leadership & Organizational Experience
15+ years of professional experience in software engineering, data engineering, machine learning, robotics, or related technical disciplines.
5+ years of engineering leadership experience as a Director or equivalent senior leadership role.
Proven success building, scaling, and leading multidisciplinary engineering organizations.
Experience hiring, mentoring, coaching, developing, and retaining engineering leaders and technical talent.
Experience leading organizations through rapid growth, organizational change, and ambiguity.

Technical Experience
Deep experience building and operating large-scale data platforms, machine learning infrastructure, or cloud-native distributed systems.
Proven experience architecting end-to-end production data and machine learning platforms, including:
Data ingestion
Storage
Processing
Feature engineering
Model training
Deployment
Monitoring
Continuous improvement

Strong understanding of modern cloud-native architectures and distributed systems.
Experience delivering production machine learning systems operating under real-world constraints such as:
Noisy data
Edge deployment
Limited connectivity

Ability to lead technical strategy and actively participate in architecture reviews and technical design discussions.

Cross-Functional Leadership
Experience partnering with Product Management, Operations, Domain Experts, Program Management, and Engineering organizations.
Demonstrated ability to influence executive stakeholders and align cross-functional teams.
Strong communication, stakeholder management, and organizational leadership skills.
Ability to balance long-term platform investments with near-term product delivery.

Personal Attributes
Strong systems thinker with excellent technical judgment.
Pragmatic leader capable of balancing architectural excellence with execution velocity.
Excellent communicator who can influence audiences across all technical levels.
Customer-focused mindset with the ability to translate business needs into technical strategy.

Education
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical discipline.

Preferred Experience And Skills

Industry Experience
Experience developing production systems in robotics, autonomy, computer vision, machine learning, AI, or physical-world applications.
Experience in agriculture, autonomous vehicles, robotics, industrial automation, construction technology, geospatial systems, or other large-scale sensor-driven environments.
Experience building products that combine cloud infrastructure, edge computing, and machine learning.
Experience working in startup or high-growth technology environments.

Machine Learning & Data Platforms
Experience with MLOps, DataOps, feature engineering, model monitoring, and modern AI infrastructure.
Experience managing large-scale telemetry, imagery, or sensor datasets.
Experience building internal platforms used by multiple engineering teams.

Organizational Leadership
Experience leading managers and manager-of-managers.
Experience defining and executing multi-year technology roadmaps.
Demonstrated success scaling engineering organizations from early-stage initiatives to mature production platforms.

Only individual applicants will be considered. We do not work with unsolicited third-party agencies or proxy interview services.

jobs.description:
About The Company

Braintrust is the agent observability platform. By actively applying intelligence to agent traces and automatically surfacing the most critical patterns, Braintrust gives teams the visibility to understand how agents behave in production and the tools to improve them.

Teams at Notion, Stripe, Box, OpenAI, and Cloudflare use Braintrust to trace their agents, find the issues in their observability data, and run evals that tell them how to improve.

About The Role

We're looking for a Director of Product Engineering to lead the team building Braintrust's core product experience.

This is a hands-on engineering leadership role for someone who cares deeply about both building great products and great engineering teams. You’ll shape how we build: setting technical direction, raising our product bar, and growing an exceptional product engineering team.

What you'll do

Build and lead an exceptional product engineering team. Build a culture of ownership, ambition, and consistently strong execution.
Make Braintrust’s UI exceptional. Raise the bar across interaction design, performance, reliability, and product polish.
Own the technical direction of the product. Evolve our frontend architecture to support increasingly sophisticated workflows, larger datasets, and a rapidly growing customer base without sacrificing speed or quality.
Stay close to the product, customers, and code. Work alongside Product and Design to understand our users, shape the roadmap, and make the technical decisions that matter most.
Deliver ambitious product capabilities at scale. Lead the team building experiences like our prompt playground, prompt management and versioning, multiplayer human review, and LLM analysis across arbitrarily large datasets.
Build products at the frontier of how teams work with AI. From prompt experimentation and versioning to multiplayer review and large-scale LLM analysis, you’ll lead the engineering behind some of our hardest product problems.

Ideal candidate credentials

A proven engineering leader who has built, managed, and scaled high-performing teams, with a track record of recruiting exceptional engineers and developing future leaders.
Exceptional product judgment and UI craft. You know what separates a good product from a world-class one and care deeply about usability, performance, interaction design, and the details.
Deep technical expertise in modern web applications. You’ve built sophisticated, data-intensive products and are comfortable with technologies like TypeScript, React, SQL, and Next.js.
A builder's mindset. You can think about organizational strategy one minute and dig into an architecture decision the next.
High ownership and a bias toward action. You thrive in fast-moving environments, make pragmatic decisions, and know how to create teams that move quickly without sacrificing quality.
Experience with startups or AI is valuable, but not required. We’d especially value experience building LLM-powered products or leading teams through rapid growth.

Modern .NET / C# (Core / 8+), ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core, SQL Server; familiarity with Angular.

Hyperscalers are partners and platforms at once, ISVs monetize their own intellectual property on top of ServiceNow, and frontier-AI and advisory partners move faster than any single motion can keep pace with. Ecosystem strategy and orchestration

Own and evolve the enterprise data strategy and technical architecture for the enterprise data platform, continuing our shift to a Medallion (bronze/silver/gold) architecture.

Job Description

About American Express Digital Labs

American Express Digital Labs catalyzes digital innovation across the enterprise by originating, incubating, and scaling products and platforms that matter to our customers’ digital lives. We combine creativity, customer centricity, and technical excellence to reimagine how Card Members experience payments and membership in a digital world.

As a fast-moving, entrepreneurial team, we partner with leading technology companies and strategic partners to bring differentiated digital payment solutions and engaging membership experiences to market.

Role Overview

As Director, Product Development – MCP Platform & Agent Ecosystem, you will define and lead the platform strategy that enables Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents, and external AI platforms to securely access American Express capabilities through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). This role will help establish how American Express participates in the rapidly evolving agent ecosystem while creating reusable foundations that power AI experiences across both external platforms and American Express digital channels.

You will own the core MCP platform, standards, and operating model that enable product teams across the company to expose capabilities in a secure, scalable, and consistent manner. Working closely with MCP use case teams and business owners, you will define best practices for tool design, authentication, authorization, documentation, evaluation, observability, personalization, and responsible AI governance. As the company’s MCP subject matter expert, you will build a center of excellence that accelerates adoption while ensuring a high bar for quality, security, compliance, and customer experience.

Success in this role requires a unique blend of platform product management, AI fluency, developer experience expertise, ecosystem thinking, and strong cross-functional leadership.

Responsibilities

Define and Lead MCP Platform Strategy

Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the American Express MCP platform.
Define the foundational capabilities required to expose American Express services to external LLMs, AI assistants, agent platforms, and internal AI experiences.
Establish platform standards, governance models, and operating principles for MCP adoption across the enterprise.
Drive alignment across engineering, architecture, security, risk, compliance, privacy, and product teams to deliver scalable platform capabilities.
Evaluate emerging MCP standards, agent ecosystems, and industry developments to continuously evolve the platform strategy.

Build the MCP Center of Excellence

Serve as the company-wide expert on MCP architecture, implementation patterns, and agent integration best practices.
Develop frameworks, guidance, and reusable patterns that enable teams to build high-quality MCP capabilities consistently.
Define standards for tool design, metadata structures, descriptions, prompts, schemas, and agent interactions.
Establish governance processes that ensure MCP capabilities are discoverable, maintainable, and optimized for AI consumption.
Drive education, enablement, and adoption efforts across product and engineering organizations.

Define Developer Experience and Integration Standards

Own the MCP developer experience for both internal and external consumers.
Establish documentation standards, onboarding experiences, reference architectures, SDK requirements, and integration frameworks.
Define how developers, partners, and AI platforms discover, authenticate, and integrate with American Express MCP capabilities.
Lead experimentation with emerging integration models, including web-based MCP architectures and next-generation agent connectivity patterns.
Drive continuous improvements to usability, adoption, and integration success rates.

Define Platform Foundations, Security, and Governance

Partner with security, identity, and platform engineering teams to define authentication and authorization models for MCP-enabled experiences.
Establish standards for OAuth, consent management, permissioning , access controls, and customer data protection.
Define scalable approaches for customer identity resolution, authorization management, and secure agent interactions.
Establish product principles and governance frameworks that define how American Express data, services, and customer information may be accessed and utilized by LLMs and AI agents.
Partner with legal, compliance, privacy, risk, and data governance teams to ensure platform capabilities align with regulatory requirements, customer expectations, and company policies.
Define standards for data minimization, consent, transparency, attribution, and appropriate AI usage.
Drive platform capabilities that enable policy enforcement, auditability, and governance across agent interactions.

Establish Quality, Evaluation, Analytics, and Observability Frameworks

Define evaluation methodologies to assess MCP tool quality, usability, discoverability, reliability, and effectiveness.
Develop measurement frameworks that assess how well tools perform across various LLMs, agent platforms, and use cases.
Partner with data science and analytics teams to establish KPIs, reporting, and performance monitoring capabilities.
Lead the development of platform-wide observability, telemetry, debugging, and monitoring solutions.
Drive continuous improvement through experimentation, measurement, and iterative optimization.

Build Personalization and Intelligence Foundations

Define platform capabilities that enable personalization and contextual intelligence across AI-enabled experiences.
Partner with data, AI, and product teams to establish reusable customer context, preference, and memory frameworks.
Identify opportunities to improve agent effectiveness through shared context and personalization services.
Ensure personalization capabilities are implemented responsibly and align with privacy and regulatory requirements.

Partner Across Product and Engineering Organizations

Collaborate closely with MCP use case teams and business owners responsible for building individual customer experiences and MCP tools.
Provide consultation, architectural guidance, and platform support throughout the product development lifecycle.
Influence roadmaps across multiple organizations to ensure consistency and alignment with platform standards.
Work closely with engineering leaders to prioritize investments that maximize platform adoption and long-term scalability.
Build strong relationships across product, engineering, architecture, security, risk, legal, and operations teams.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

8+ years of product management experience, with significant experience leading platform, API, developer platform, or infrastructure products.
Proven experience defining product strategy and delivering large-scale platform capabilities across multiple stakeholder groups.
Experience building developer-facing products, APIs, SDKs, or ecosystem platforms.
Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, identity, OAuth, consent management, platform security, and data governance concepts.
Experience working across legal, compliance, privacy, and risk stakeholders to launch customer-facing platform capabilities.
Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in highly cross-functional environments and influence without direct authority.
Experience defining product metrics, experimentation frameworks, and data-driven decision-making processes.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business outcomes.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working with Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents, agentic systems, MCP, function calling, tool orchestration, or related technologies.
Experience building products for developer ecosystems, partner integrations, marketplaces, or platform businesses.
Knowledge of MCP standards, agent frameworks, AI tooling ecosystems, and emerging industry patterns.
Experience defining AI governance, responsible AI controls, model evaluation frameworks, or AI platform standards.
Experience defining observability, telemetry, monitoring, analytics, or platform measurement capabilities.
Familiarity with personalization platforms, customer context systems, conversational AI experiences, or AI-driven recommendation capabilities.
Experience partnering with security, identity, privacy, and enterprise architecture organizations on platform-scale initiatives.
Experience leading products in highly regulated industries such as financial services, payments, fintech, or technology.
Advanced degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.

SaaS and cloud-native platforms, strong knowledge of health records management, ETL

operational efficiency.

Lead, mentor, and develop high-performing engineering teams responsible for Health

Strong technical foundation in modern software engineering principles, architecture, API design, integration patterns, cloud platforms, DevOps practices, and operational excellence.

Strong data engineering experience, including ETL/ELT pipeline design, data quality management, data transformation, and scalable cloud-based data processing.

Experience guiding the use of AI models in production or enterprise workflows, including model integration, prompt/model evaluation, responsible AI practices, data privacy, and human-in-the-loop review patterns.
Experience partnering with product management, architecture, DevOps, information security, QA, operations, and senior business stakeholders.
Strong understanding of Agile delivery practices, engineering governance, risk management, dependency management, and continuous improvement.
Excellent leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and decision-making skills.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Experience in healthcare, health information management, medical records, release of information, clinical document workflows, or regulated records environments. HL7 FHIR is a strong plus.
Experience designing automation for document onboarding, classification, indexing, extraction, validation, or workflow orchestration.
Experience with Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, React or Angular, microservices, containers, Kubernetes, and modern CI/CD practices.
Experience with cloud-native composite architectures and enterprise SaaS platforms.
Experience applying AI/ML, OCR, NLP, large language models, or intelligent document processing to business workflows.
